command.commentCheck: Comment on the MR about this check
config.oauthApplications: OAuth application per GitLab instance, to sign in with SSO in the browser: `{ "https://gitlab.com": "<Application ID>" }`. Create it in GitLab > Preferences > Applications with the redirect URI `vscode://gwen1230.mr-review/authentication`, "Confidential" unchecked and the `api` scope. Without an application, a personal access token is asked for.
config.markViewedOnNext: "Next file" marks the file you leave as viewed.
config.triageDirectory: Folder of triage files (`<branch>.json`, `/` replaced by `-`; format described in the README). The files view follows their reading order. Reload the window after changing it.
config.showAllChecksInEditor: Show every triage check at the end of its line, not only the blocking ones (🛑). Line hover and the view always show them all.
config.triageCommand: Shell command that triages the MR of the checked-out branch, run at the repository root by "Run triage". It must write `$MR_REVIEW_TRIAGE_FILE` (format described in the README). Environment: `MR_REVIEW_REPO`, `MR_REVIEW_BRANCH`, `MR_REVIEW_TARGET`, `MR_REVIEW_HEAD`, `MR_REVIEW_BASE`, `MR_REVIEW_IID`, `MR_REVIEW_URL`, `MR_REVIEW_TRIAGE_FILE`. Empty: no triage button.
config.reviewWorktree: Git worktree dedicated to reviews (`~` allowed), e.g. `~/code/my-app.worktrees/review`. "Review in VS Code" ("Project MRs" view) switches it to the MR branch when no worktree has it checked out yet, then opens it. Refused if the worktree has uncommitted changes.
description: Review a GitLab merge request in VS Code's native diff: Cmd+click navigation on the real file, comments posted to the merge request.
